_comment: Ratchet floors for the issue-hunt backlog brake (REQ-ISSUE-CLASS-RATCHET).
A floor is whatever the needs-decision queue measured at the first fully
classified pass. It can only tighten. null means: not yet measured, so the
brake cannot fire for that repo and check-issue-classes.py says so rather
than inventing a number nobody can defend.
agent-closable is deliberately uncapped — the brake must never throttle
